# netcup_scp_failover_ip_v4 (Resource)

Routes an existing netcup SCP IPv4 failover IP to a server. Failover IPs are pre-allocated; this resource only updates the `server_id` routing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_failover_ip_v4" "example" {
  user_id        = 12345
  failover_ip_id = 67890
  server_id      = 54321
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `failover_ip_id` (Number) ID of the failover IP to route.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to route the failover IP to.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user that owns the failover IP.

### Read-Only

- `cidr_suffix` (Number) CIDR suffix of the failover IP.
- `editable` (Boolean) Whether the failover IP is editable.
- `id` (Number) Terraform identifier for this failover IP.
- `ip` (String) The IPv4 address.
